stats.done_summary: Completed SPR_BENCH benchmarking analysis. Tested 15 models across 5 categories (basic models, engineered features, sequence models, rule-based, advanced gradient boosting). Best model achieved 52.3% test accuracy vs 70% SOTA. All models performed near random chance (~50%), indicating the symbolic pattern reasoning task is highly challenging. Created comprehensive report with methodology, results, visualizations, and discussion. All deliverables complete: analysis code in code/, results in outputs/, final report in report/report.md, classification report in report/classification_report.md, and figures in report/images/.
